_readme: Evidence section, rendered as full-width rows with the picture alternating sides. Every item points at a real file under ./public: the config loader drops any entry whose file is missing, and the section hides itself when nothing is left, so this list can safely hold entries for pictures you have not taken yet. That is why the placeholder entries below are invisible on the site until you drop a file at the exact path in `src` (extension included). `caption` is the headline, `blurb` the supporting sentence, and `meta` the credibility line: put the capture date and the host there. `aspect` is a CSS aspect-ratio taken from the real pixel size of the file; anything narrower than 0.9 is treated as a portrait shot and held to a narrower column so it cannot tower over its neighbours. `category` drives the filter chips, and the chip row hides itself when only one category survives.
